title: Sky36 Danang: High Altitude Luxury
description: Unwind at Sky36 on the 36th floor of Novotel Danang. Spectacular panoramic Han River views, VIP bottle service, and Da Nang's premier rooftop lounge.
content:
> **Executive Summary:**
>
> *   Sky36, located on the 36th floor of the Novotel in Danang, offers a 3+ hour, high-energy nightlife experience with panoramic views of the Han River and coastal skyline. It features molecular cocktails, international DJs, LED dance performances, and fire shows.
> *   AGS clients receive priority reservations, skip-the-line access via express elevator, and luxury private SUV transfers, ensuring a seamless, high-standard experience at this year-round venue.
> *   The venue's ultra-luxurious, multi-level design includes world-class audio systems and glass-bottomed floors, with VIP booths on the balcony edge providing unhindered views.
>
> *Related: Explore our [Premium Southeast Asia Tours](/tours/) luxury itinerary.*

## The AGS Executive Summary
Elevate your evening on the 36th floor. Sky36 is Danang's premier nightlife destination, offering phenomenal panoramic views of the Han River and sweeping coastal skyline.

## The Operator & Origin Story
The rapid development of Danang created a demand for true international-standard nightlife. Sky36 answered this by building an ultra-luxurious, multi-level sky bar atop the Novotel, featuring world-class audio systems and glass-bottomed floors.

## The Itinerary & Deep Dive
You are escorted directly passed the ground queues to the express elevator. Your VIP reservation secures a premium booth right on the balcony edge, completely unhindered by glass. 

Mixologists serve molecular cocktails as international DJs spin upscale house music. Later in the evening, the venue features stunning LED dance performances and fire shows framed against the spectacular neon-lit Dragon Bridge far below.

## Experience Data
| Metric | Details |
|---|---|
| **Vibe / Atmosphere** | Glamorous, High-Energy, Panoramic |
| **Duration** | 3+ Hours (Late Night) |
| **Physical Demand** | Low |
| **Best Paired With** | A celebration night during a Danang golf tour. |

## The 36th-Floor Trophy Celebration Overlooking the Han River & Dragon Bridge
Towering 166 meters above Bach Dang Promenade atop the Novotel Danang Premier Han River, **Sky36** is Central Vietnam’s highest open-air rooftop lounge and the benchmark venue for a final-night tournament celebration during [The Coastal Sprint](/tours/the-coastal-sprint/) or [Vietnam Central Coast](/tours/vietnam-central-coast/). After testing your game across the fast coastal dunes of [Hoiana Shores Golf Club](/courses/vietnam/hoiana-shores/), the illuminated mountain fairways of [Ba Na Hills Golf Club](/courses/vietnam/ba-na-hills/), and the bulkhead greens of [BRG Da Nang Nicklaus Course](/courses/vietnam/brg-da-nang-nicklaus/), ascending via Sky36’s glass-walled express elevator gives your group a 360-degree vantage point over the Han River bridges, Son Tra Peninsula, and the East Sea coastline.

## Weekend Dragon Bridge Fire Views, Dress Code & VIP Booths
* **Timing the Saturday/Sunday 9:00 PM Dragon Bridge Show:** On Friday, Saturday, and Sunday nights at 9:00 PM sharp, Da Nang’s iconic Dragon Bridge (*Cầu Rồng*) breathes fire and water across the Han River. Arriving at Sky36 at 8:30 PM lets your group watch the illuminated river spectacle from above with zero street crowd congestion before the resident DJs and LED dancers ramp up the 36th-floor energy at 10:00 PM.
* **Strictly Enforced Smart-Casual Dress Code:** Sky36 prohibits flip-flops, beach sandals, athletic tank tops, and swimwear; gentlemen in your golf group should wear collared shirts or smart polos, tailored trousers or dark chinos, and closed-toe shoes.
* **Standby Chauffeur Return to Da Nang or An Bang:** Whether your group is staying 10 minutes away at [InterContinental Danang Sun Peninsula Resort](/accommodations/vietnam/intercontinental-danang/) and [Fusion Resort & Villas Da Nang](/accommodations/vietnam/fusion-resort-villa-da-nang/) or 35 minutes south in a private [An Bang Beachfront Villa](/accommodations/vietnam/an-bang-beach-villas/), your private luxury MPV waits downstairs at the Novotel porte-cochère until your party is ready to depart.

## Celebrating Your Final Round on the Vietnam Central Coast
For groups wrapping up four championship rounds across [Hoiana Shores Golf Club](/courses/vietnam/hoiana-shores/), [Ba Na Hills Golf Club](/courses/vietnam/ba-na-hills/), [BRG Da Nang Golf Resort](/courses/vietnam/brg-da-nang-norman/), and [Laguna Golf Lăng Cô](/courses/vietnam/laguna-lang-co/), reserving a glass-edge VIP booth on the 36th floor of Sky36 after a private seafood dinner on the Son Tra Peninsula provides an unforgettable final-night celebration before your departure from Da Nang International Airport.

faqs.q: What is the dress code for golfers visiting Sky36 on the 36th floor in Da Nang?
faqs.a: Sky36 strictly enforces a smart-casual dress code: gentlemen must wear closed-toe shoes, collared shirts or smart polos, and tailored trousers or dress shorts (flip-flops, slides, and sleeveless shirts are not permitted).

faqs.q: Can you see the Dragon Bridge fire show from Sky36 in Da Nang?
faqs.a: Yes. Sky36's 36th-floor open-air deck overlooks the entire Han River corridor, offering an elevated panoramic view of the Dragon Bridge, Han River Swing Bridge, and Thuan Phuoc Bridge illuminated on weekend nights.

faqs.q: How far is Sky36 from Da Nang's golf resorts and An Bang Beachfront Villas?
faqs.a: Located on Bach Dang Street in central Da Nang, Sky36 is a 15-minute private SUV transfer from Fusion Resort & Villas Da Nang and BRG Da Nang Golf Resort, and a 35-minute drive from An Bang Beachfront Villas and Hoi An.
